  WHY: An agent on the PR head may only run step 2's fetch and diff checks, leaving the project branch unsynced and the verification check failing.

- workflow-templates/.claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md:step 3, line 189 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The blocker-evidence diff assumes `origin/<project branch>` was fetched successfully and does not specify structured evidence when the fetch fails.

  WHY: This is a maintainer-facing inconsistency; copying prose between the commands can leave a placeholder that references a nonexistent remote ref.
- workflow-templates/.claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md:line 182 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3]

  WHY: A literal reading may cause redundant fetch and diff operations for a default-bound PR head or project branch.
